title: Medical office, interior-only renovation of a leased suite — Mayagüez, coastal zone (zone X)
description: Our medical office in Mayagüez is relocating to a leased suite near the bay. We will do an interior renovation only: new partition walls and electrical work inside the suite. No exterior work.

mustInclude.rationale: RULE_0002 municipality baseline: every business gets the IRS EIN. (KB: RULE_0002, RULE_0620)
RULE_0003 municipality baseline: Registro de Comerciante (SURI). (KB: RULE_0003)
RULE_0651: new LLC -> Certificate of Organization (Departamento de Estado). (KB: RULE_0651)
RULE_0004 municipality baseline: Patente Municipal (Ley 107-2020 Codigo Municipal). (KB: RULE_0004)
RULE_0007: a physical commercial premises (Q_PHYSICAL_LOCATION) -> Permiso Unico (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0007)
RULE_0643/0644: project_type new_construction / renovation -> OGPe construction permit (Ley 161-2009). (KB: RULE_0643)
RULE_0088: medical office -> physician licensing. (KB: RULE_0016, RULE_0029, RULE_0088)
RULE_0683: Q_MEDICAL_WASTE -> biomedical-waste generator registration. (KB: RULE_0683)

mustNotInclude.rationale: Pin in FEMA zone X: RULE_0706/0707 need location.flood_zone.sfha / floodway, which zone X never sets.
No SREP land and no change of use in a residential/conservation/agricultural district: RULE_0709-0712 cannot fire.
No renewable installation: RULE_0610 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No renewable installation: RULE_0611 needs Q_RENEWABLE_INSTALL=true.
No microgrid stated: PT_MICROGRID needs microgrid_configuration=true; energy.test.ts: 'a rooftop system is not assumed to be a microgrid'.

Interior-only renovation of a leased suite has no coastal effect: CZMA federal consistency (15 CFR 930.57) applies to federally permitted activities; RULE_0708 fires on any renovation (heuristic, flagged EXPERT VALIDATION NEEDED).

ordering.rationale: KB documents.json: DOC_PERMISO_UNICO.depends_on_document_ids = [DOC_OGPE_CONSTRUCTION_PERMIT] (use permit after construction).
KB documents.json: DOC_PATENTE_MUNICIPAL.depends_on_document_ids = [DOC_PERMISO_UNICO] (patente after the use permit).
